title: Mueller Budget Set for $4.4M Approval
summary:
Mueller Budget Set for $4.4M Approval

*   A significant decision will be made on the operating budget for the Mueller Redevelopment Project for fiscal years 2026-2027.
*   The proposed budget allocates over $4.4 million to support the project's ongoing operations and development.
*   The Mueller Local Government Corporation will meet to approve this critical funding, alongside other routine administrative items.
